record.field:
if record.pet_ok: description = "CHIP: " if record.barcode: description += str(record.barcode) + "
" else: description += "
"
description += "Especie: " if record.categ_id.id: description += record.categ_id.name + "
" else: description += "
"
description += "Raza: " if record.pet_breed: description += str(record.pet_breed) + "
" else: description += "
"
description += "Sexo: " if record.sex == "male": description += "Macho" + "
" elif record.sex == "female": description += "Hembra" + "
" else: description += "
"
description += "Fecha de nacimiento: " if record.birthdate: description += str(record.birthdate.strftime('%d/%m/%Y')) + "
" else: description += "
"
if record.pet_color: description += "Color: " + record.pet_color + "
" if record.hair: description += "Pelaje: " + str(record.hair) + "
"
description += "Vacunas: " if record.pet_vaccine: description += str(record.pet_vaccine) + "
" else: description += "
"
description += "Esterilizado: " if record.pet_castration: description += record.pet_castration + "
" else: description += "
"
description += "Desparasitado: " if record.pet_deworming: description += record.pet_deworming + "
" else: description += "
"
